name: join_collapse_limit
description: Controls the maximum number of FROM items after which explicit JOIN constructs are not flattened into a single FROM list; affects join reordering and plan generation.
symptoms: Poor execution plans for complex multi-table joins
Unintended join reordering despite explicit JOIN syntax
tuning_tips: Set to 1 to disable join flattening and enforce explicit join order for predictable plans; increase only if queries with many explicit JOINs suffer from poor plan choices, but monitor planning overhead.
